title: Birth in 1901 and hearing Buddy Bolden at age six or seven
summary: Barbarin gives his birth date and place and recalls hearing Buddy Bolden's band across from his home as a small child.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Bob Arburn, March 27th, 1957, Real 1. My name is Bob Arburn. Your name is Bob Campbell, right? Right. Bob Campbell. Hello, Bob. How are you? How are you? When were you born, Paul? Well, I tell you, I was born May the 5th. 1901.
Where? What part of this city?

I was born at New Orleans, Louisiana, at Barracks and St. Claude, right on the corner of Barracks and St. Claude. I did remember hearing Buddy Bowling because Buddy Bowling was playing a banquet at the place of Burns Hall. That's on Burrow between Annette and Seminole. And I was living on Equat in the back back back street from the Hall between Annette and Seminole. And Buddy was Buddy Bowling. The band was blowing. And the people was dancing, I imagine. And having a good time. My mom happened to call to say, that's Buddy Bowling blowing over there. That man sure can blow. That was about, let's see what year. I would say that was around 19... Six or seven. I was just a kid. I would say just about six or seven. I remember that. I can remember that.
